    Exceptional contours, one contour at a time #

    Q2Pair v w: the contour v = ρ ρ, w = a β of the exceptional penny-farthing, with the conditions that let one twist β (Q2Src) or a (Q2Tgt) by a unit. PFData.exit_q2src: an open penny-farthing satisfies Q2Src (by LPF, no tiny point and the case-2 analysis).
